title: agent-crew task quality metrics
description: Optional evaluator/reviewer-labeled quality signal file. Lives at {TASK_DIR}/context/quality-metrics.json and is consumed by telemetry operational_quality metrics before text-signal fallbacks.

hallucination_detected.description: True only when a reviewer/evaluator explicitly found factual hallucination or unsupported factual claims.

rollback_performed.description: True when the workflow performed or required rollback/revert to recover from unsafe changes.

human_intervention_required.description: True when a human/operator intervention was required beyond normal approval gates.

evidence_paths.description: Relative paths under the task directory that support the labels.
